verdict.rationale: Honeybadger provides error grouping, search/query (BadgerQL), deploy-linked regression views ('occurred.after:last deploy'), and anomaly detection on volume deviations, which support trend-spotting for errors. However, there's no explicit evidence of a cross-project/team leadership dashboard aggregating top regressions, new issues per release, and volume over time in one view — the evidence shows per-project query/alarm features rather than a unified engineering-leader rollup dashboard. missing for 10: explicit multi-project/team rollup dashboard, per-release issue breakdowns, and leadership-level aggregate reporting evidence.
